scope: Official public descriptions and proposed game adaptations; no episode video or game runtime tested.

proposedActivities.showReference: Bluey searches for hidden family members
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Tap a hiding place while a parent seeks
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Both hide, or alternate child seeker/hider roles

proposedActivities.showReference: The children enlist a pretend robot for tidying
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Feed a toy to a large helper basket
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: One collects; one directs the robot to picture destinations

proposedActivities.showReference: The children run a hotel with Dad as guest
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Put a pillow on a guest bed; ring a bell
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Reception, room setup, and snack delivery; freely exchange jobs

proposedActivities.showReference: Friends negotiate shop roles and scan items
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Drag an item across a big scanner for a satisfying beep
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: One shops while the other scans and bags; roles never block starting

proposedActivities.showReference: An indoor pretend taxi trip has comic interruptions
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Tap a destination picture; an assisted taxi follows a safe route
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Driver, passenger, and mechanic activities; let either child change roles

proposedActivities.showReference: Dad is a train linking pretend daily destinations
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Tap a station to ride and ring the bell
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Choose stops, deliver passengers, and set up destination play areas

proposedActivities.showReference: Doctor and nurse play reveals a silly animal in Dad's tummy
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Tap a toy scanner and place a bandage sticker
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: One scans, one offers toy treatments; the patient gives funny reactions

proposedActivities.showReference: Janet and Rita dress up, cause mischief, and dance
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Put on glasses and a blanket, then choose a dance
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Both invent a granny scene and tidy pretend spilled beans afterward

proposedActivities.showReference: The children make mud pizzas and deliver them
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Decorate a base and serve to a nearby parent
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: One prepares; the other delivers; add a toy-car mechanic later

proposedActivities.showReference: Dad builds Bingo's cake; Bluey helps with the mess
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Decorate a ready-shaped duck
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Assemble, ice, decorate, serve, and optionally clean together

proposedActivities.showReference: Bingo gathers colors for a pretend salad
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Put large colorful ingredients in a bowl
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: One gathers, one mixes and sets the table; no urgent customer demands

proposedActivities.showReference: Bluey and Bingo host their parents for a meal
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Place one plate and serve a creation
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Make a menu, prepare food, and take turns as chef and server

proposedActivities.showReference: Bath play becomes a burger shop
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Stack three large burger pieces
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Assemble different picture orders while the other child plates or washes

proposedActivities.showReference: Kitchen café play includes a competing pretend chef
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Add fruit and decorations to a dessert
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Run adjacent café counters and serve each other, without a winner requirement

proposedActivities.showReference: Cushions and blankets form an expanding playhouse
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Snap a cushion or blanket into a broad target
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Build connected nooks, furnish them, and place a toy inside

proposedActivities.showReference: Felt pens become objects in an imaginary island world
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Arrange oversized pretend sticks as food or a shelter
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Build a shared island and act out fishing/foraging with a parent

proposedActivities.showReference: A pretend instrument freezes Dad
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Tap a note to freeze/unfreeze a willing parent in a funny pose
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: One plays, the other adds a hat or chooses a pose; share turns

proposedActivities.showReference: Bingo's feather makes objects pretend-heavy
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Tap a prop and watch a parent struggle comically
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Change heavy/light states to arrange a silly obstacle scene

proposedActivities.showReference: Magic asparagus makes family members act like animals
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Choose an animal picture; a parent imitates it
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Both build a pretend zoo and switch animal roles

proposedActivities.showReference: The family dances and plays with stop/start rules
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Tap to dance; automatically settle into a pose when music pauses
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Choose poses and respond to a generous visual/audio stop cue together

proposedActivities.showReference: Bingo can prompt her parents to dance
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Big dance picture triggers a funny parent routine
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Take turns selecting moves or build a short joint routine

proposedActivities.showReference: Party passing uses different prize rules
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Assisted passing, followed by a big unwrap gesture
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Children choose wrapping and pass to each other or NPCs; no elimination

proposedActivities.showReference: Bluey and Mackenzie race bark in a school fountain
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Put a decorated boat in a wide launch area
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Each makes a boat; guide both to a landing or take turns sending a leaf passenger

proposedActivities.showReference: The children try to move a floppy Dad
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Drag a large handle to help Dad onto a cushion
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Alternate gentle pushes along a short shared route

proposedActivities.showReference: The family keeps a balloon off the ground
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Large slow balloon, broad tap region, gentle automatic rescue
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Both bat the same balloon or guide it through broad targets

proposedActivities.showReference: Children move between shadows and avoid sunny grass
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Tap a large nearby shadow and auto-walk there
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Choose a route together; later add slowly moving shade

proposedActivities.showReference: The sisters avoid touching the floor
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Tap big cushions; automatic safe hops
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: One arranges a route, the other crosses; either can leave freely

proposedActivities.showReference: A letter becomes a paper plane to reach Mum
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Deliver a picture card to a nearby mailbox
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Decorate, fold, and send letters to each other or a parent

proposedActivities.showReference: A backyard course becomes a race
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Follow three broad stations without a timer
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Build routes and take turns; personal timing is optional

proposedActivities.showReference: The official page also identifies Memory Snap
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Match two large face-up pictures
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Use a few face-down pairs and cooperate on a shared board

proposedActivities.showReference: Bluey and Mum try to dam rainwater
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Drop a broad barrier into a shallow channel
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Arrange channels and barriers together, then clean muddy tracks

proposedActivities.showReference: The family regularly takes out the bins
proposedActivities.simplePlay: Put a marked cleanup prop in a picture bin
proposedActivities.cooperativePlay: Collect, sort, and wheel bins with a parent
